segments.sn22.5:1.1: Evaṃ me sutaṃ – ekaṃ samayaṃ bhagavā sāvatthiyaṃ viharati jetavane anāthapiṇḍikassa ārāme.
segments.sn22.5:1.3: Tatra kho bhagavā bhikkhū āmantesi – “bhikkhavo”ti. “Bhadante”ti te bhikkhū bhagavato paccassosuṃ. Bhagavā etadavoca –
segments.sn22.5:1.7: Rūpassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca, vedanāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca, saññāya samudayañca atthaṅgamañca, saṅkhārānaṃ samudayañca atthaṅgamañca, viññāṇassa samudayañca atthaṅgamañca”.
segments.sn22.5:2.1: “Ko ca, bhikkhave, rūpassa samudayo, ko vedanāya samudayo, ko saññāya samudayo, ko saṅkhārānaṃ samudayo, ko viññāṇassa samudayo?
segments.sn22.5:2.2: Idha, bhikkhave, bhikkhu abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn22.5:3.3: Tassa rūpaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī.
segments.sn22.5:4.1: “Vedanaṃ abhinandati … pe … saññaṃ abhinandati … saṅkhāre abhinandati … viññāṇaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn22.5:4.5: Tassa viññāṇaṃ abhinandato abhivadato ajjhosāya tiṭṭhato uppajjati nandī.
segments.sn22.5:4.9: jātipaccayā … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa samudayo hoti.
segments.sn22.5:6.1: “Ko ca, bhikkhave, rūpassa atthaṅgamo, ko vedanāya … ko saññāya … ko saṅkhārānaṃ … ko viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo?
segments.sn22.5:7.1: Idha, bhikkhave, nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn22.5:8.3: Tassa rūpaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā rūpe nandī sā nirujjhati.
segments.sn22.5:8.5: upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
segments.sn22.5:9.2: Tassa vedanaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosā tiṭṭhato yā vedanāya nandī sā nirujjhati.
segments.sn22.5:9.4: upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
segments.sn22.5:10.1: “Saññaṃ nābhinandati … pe … saṅkhāre nābhinandati nābhivadati nājjhosāya tiṭṭhati.
segments.sn22.5:10.3: Tassa saṅkhāre anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā saṅkhāresu nandī sā nirujjhati.
segments.sn22.5:10.5: upādānanirodhā bhavanirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
segments.sn22.5:11.2: Tassa viññāṇaṃ anabhinandato anabhivadato anajjhosāya tiṭṭhato yā viññāṇe nandī sā nirujjhati.
segments.sn22.5:11.3: Tassa nandīnirodhā upādānanirodho … pe … evametassa kevalassa dukkhakkhandhassa nirodho hoti.
segments.sn22.5:12.1: “Ayaṃ, bhikkhave, rūpassa atthaṅgamo, ayaṃ vedanāya atthaṅgamo, ayaṃ saññāya atthaṅgamo, ayaṃ saṅkhārānaṃ atthaṅgamo, ayaṃ viññāṇassa atthaṅgamo”ti.

lines: Pañcame samādhinti idaṃ bhagavā te bhikkhū cittekaggatāya parihāyante disvā,“cittekaggataṃ labhantānaṃ imesaṃ kammaṭṭhānaṃ phātiṃ gamissatī”ti ñatvā āha.
Abhivadatīti tāya abhinandanāya “aho piyaṃ iṭṭhaṃ kantaṃ manāpan”ti vadati.
Vācaṃ abhinandantopi ca taṃ ārammaṇaṃ nissāya evaṃ lobhaṃ uppādento abhivadatiyeva nāma.
Yā rūpe nandīti yā sā rūpe balavapatthanāsaṅkhātā nandī.
Vipassanācittena cetasā “aniccaṃ dukkhan”ti vacībhedaṃ karontopi nābhivadatiyeva.
“Aho piyaṃ iṭṭhan”ti vacībhede asatipi tathā lobhuppāde sati abhivadatiyeva nāma.
“Mama idan”ti attano pariṇāmetvā anaññagocaraṃ viya katvā gaṇhanto ajjhosāya tiṭṭhati nāmāti dassento āha “gilitvāti pariniṭṭhapetvā gaṇhātī”ti.
Paṭhamehi padehi anusayo, pacchimena pariyuṭṭhānanti keci “gahaṇaṭṭhena upādānan”ti katvā.
Nābhinandati nābhivadatīti ettha heṭṭhā vuttavipariyāyena attho veditabbo.
Na “iṭṭhaṃ kantan”ti vadatīti “iṭṭhan”ti na vadati,“kantan”ti na vadati.
